# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 2: Where AI Came From** (Weeks 2-3)

The story of AI from the 1950s to ChatGPT. The big dreams, the big failures, and the moments that changed everything. We will build a class timeline, watch some great short films, and meet the people who built the tools we use today.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Tell the story of AI from the 1950s to today
* Explain why early AI built on rules did not work for seeing and language
* Name the people and moments that changed AI
* Build a class timeline
